methodology.universe: Strict cohort uses Hyperliquid-origin alerts. Broad cohort uses assets in the current Hyperliquid catalog, which introduces survivorship/listing-timing uncertainty.
methodology.entry: First saved 1m/3m/5m checkpoint satisfying confirmation, adverse-move, and extension rules.
methodology.exit: First saved checkpoint satisfying hard stop, target, trailing, time stop, or 240m maximum.
methodology.costs: 0.130% round trip for base taker fees and modeled slippage; historical spread unavailable and therefore omitted.
methodology.squeezeCaveat: Saved post-alert open interest is unavailable. Squeeze Pressure results are a price-confirmation upper bound and do not enforce the live bot covering requirement.
methodology.pathCaveat: Checkpoint data cannot establish the ordering of stop, target, and trailing events between observations.
